content:
maya: Heads-up — I'm rewriting the Get started quickstart to remove the Docker step and add a VS Code devcontainer + local token flow. Goal: folks can run the hello app with no docker installed and we show the recommended short-lived token workflow. PR soon.

alex: Love that. Do we need to touch any auth wording (env var names)?

maya: Yes — current snippet uses REDWOOD_API_KEY which we've deprecated in favor of REDWOOD_TOKEN for the new short-lived helper. Need to update examples and callouts.

kevin: Quick note: search/replace will break older screenshots. Can we keep a small compatibility note instead of removing all references?

maya: Good point. My plan: replace primary examples with REDWOOD_TOKEN + devcontainer flow, and add a small "If you have REDWOOD_API_KEY" compatibility box.

jen: If you're changing the snippet, please also update the Python and Node examples. I'll volunteer to sanity-check the Node one.

sanjay: I can run the devcontainer on Windows + WSL and confirm the steps. Anything I should watch for?

maya: Thanks — mainly the token helper steps. We'll add a short callout with the CLI sequence:
```bash
# install helper (mac/linux)
curl -sSfL https://get.redwood.sh/rwd-auth | sh
# create short-lived token for local dev
rwd-auth login --scopes=chat:write --expires=1h
export REDWOOD_TOKEN=$(rwd-auth current-token)
node hello.js
```

alex: Nice. Add a line that the helper writes to keychain/credential manager to avoid plain-text in dotfiles.

maya: Will do. Also the quickstart will show a minimal devcontainer.json with ports forwarded and the env var mount.

kevin: For the docs site, we should include a small screenshot of the devcontainer popup and a short sentence about remote containers being optional.

docs-bot: PR created — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1427 by maya (labels: docs, quickstart, devcontainer).

jen: Reviewing now — leaving inline comments on the Node snippet about changing client.auth to client.setToken (SDK 1.4 rename).

maya: Thanks — will patch.

sanjay: I ran the build in the container. One tiny snag: the example uses node 18 but ubuntu-latest image defaults to 20 in the devcontainer base. I pushed a small tweak to the branch to pin runtime.

maya: Great, thanks. @alex can you LGTM once jen and kevin's comments resolved?

alex: Yup — will do a quick pass tomorrow morning.

maya: Plan: merge after two approvals and then schedule a tiny site hotfix deploy. If anything else surfaces from the Windows run I'll follow up. :thumbsup:

kevin: fyi I'll add a 1-line redirect in the troubleshooting section to handle any stale links referencing the old docker quickstart.

maya: Awesome, thanks everyone.
